summary.intent: Use the GSD manager workflow to close out milestone v2.0 in the cipher-box repo: verify/plan/execute the remaining phases (69, 70.1, 74, 75, 76, 77, 78, 79), resuming autonomously across quota-limited sessions via scheduled cron wakeups, and ship Phase 74 through the full post-execution review pipeline.
summary.outcome: Phases 69, 70.1, 75, and 77 were verified/completed; Phase 74 was planned, executed, gap-closure fixed (hex/base64 encoding bug, dirty-resume key-surfacing gap, WinFsp rename kind-mismatch guard) and opened as PR #607 with most CI green, pending final confirmation. Phases 76, 78, 79 remain unplanned after the user paused a fresh Phase 76 agent.

repo: The share API wire contract is uniformly hex-encoded (encryptedReadKey, encryptedWriteKey, itemNameEncrypted, sharerPublicKey) enforced by DTO @Matches regex, while internal node-codec/stored-sealed fields (readKeySealed, persist_wrapped_key) are base64 — same Uint8Array type, opposite encodings, nothing enforces the distinction, causing this bug class to recur repeatedly per the user.
vitest does not load .env files — SDK_E2E_SECRET must be exported inline into the shell running the suite or the harness falls back to a default secret and gets 401s from the API.
A stale `node dist/main.js` API process can linger (started hours earlier, detached/PPID 1) serving an old TEST_LOGIN_SECRET, producing false 401 test failures that look like code defects.

EnterWorktree refuses to pin a freshly-spawned sub-agent (launched at repo root) into a pre-existing worktree — background agents can only operate correctly if the main checkout itself is already switched to the target worktree/branch.

GSD's plan-file scanner (plan-scan.cjs:28) has a loose case-insensitive `PLAN` substring fallback that miscounts any .md file containing that substring (e.g. `69-WRITE-PLANE-RESEARCH.md`, 'write-PLANE') as an extra plan file, causing implementation_complete to read false and the dashboard to falsely show 'Executing'.
The manager's `is_active` flag just means 'a file in the phase dir was modified in the last 5 minutes' — not an indicator of a real running agent.

WinFsp's rename handler lacked the kind-mismatch (file-vs-directory) destination guard that the fuser rename path enforces before its non-empty-folder check, allowing revocation-mutation on a wrong-kind overwrite.
GSD's commit helper can report `commit_failed` while the commit actually landed — always verify with `git log --oneline -1` rather than retrying blindly.
`gh pr edit` fails on this repo due to Projects-classic GraphQL incompatibility; PR body edits must go through `gh api -X PATCH`.
markdownlint excludes `.planning/` on commit but prettier still runs against files there.
Desktop E2E is a workflow_dispatch-gated GitHub Action and must be triggered explicitly per branch rather than running automatically on PR open.

code.finding: re_mint_grants_rooted_at used base64_encode for the share-grant encryptedReadKey field, but the API validates it as hex — caused runtime 400s that broke SC#2 grant re-mint; fixed to hex::encode.

Rust's dirty-resume repair path discarded the rotatedNodes map on early return (fresh_root.map(..)); TS repairDirtyNode never inserted the recovered key at all — both fixed to surface repaired-descendant keys.

TS rotatedNodes map stores references (not defensive copies like Rust's .clone()), aliasing the same buffer as parentNewReadKey — latent zeroing hazard if a future change zeros parentNewReadKey; flagged as a todo, only partially addressed in the repair path.

handle_rename's destination validation only rejected non-empty-folder overwrites, missing the kind-mismatch (file vs directory) guard that fuser's rename.rs applies before the non-empty check — ported STATUS_NOT_A_DIRECTORY/STATUS_FILE_IS_A_DIRECTORY guard from fuser.
Loose /PLAN/i substring fallback matches any .md filename containing 'PLAN' (case-insensitive) as a phase plan file, causing false plan-count overcounts.

workflow: Cron-based one-shot resumes (CronCreate) can carry an autonomous GSD session across quota-reset windows, but the resume prompt must be re-authored each time to reflect corrected strategy and accurate on-disk progress rather than assumptions from prior notifications.

Background agents that build their own internal wait/poll loops can stall or terminate early without truly finishing work — instruct sub-agents to run pipelines synchronously to completion rather than self-scheduling waits.

When resuming multi-phase autonomous work, verify actual on-disk state (git log, plan/summary file counts, VERIFICATION status) rather than trusting agent notification summaries, which can undercount or misreport actual progress.
Serialize phase execution when phases share a database/docker stack — parallel worktree-isolated execution breaks pnpm/cargo verify commands that need the installed workspace.
Delegate long-running/analysis-heavy ship-phase gates (secure, crypto-review, security-review, simplify, SDK-E2E) to separate sequential sub-agents to avoid resource contention on the shared stack.

CodeRabbit CLI (local, --type committed) and unit tests can miss real integration bugs (like the hex/base64 mismatch) that only surface via a live E2E test hitting the real API — the CLI review flagged only doc-bookkeeping issues, not the actual code defect.

friction: Two background planner agents (Phase 74, 75) failed identically trying to use EnterWorktree from repo root into an existing worktree, wasting a cycle before pivoting to sequential main-checkout-per-branch.

Session hit quota limits multiple times (resets at 4:40am and 9:40am Europe/Berlin), interrupting three parallel background planners mid-work and requiring scheduled cron resumes with corrected instructions each time.

A relaunched 'Plan-finish and execute Phase 75' agent stopped early after only 21 minutes due to a self-made background-wait loop, not quota exhaustion, requiring a second relaunch with explicit synchronous-execution instructions.
A stale API process serving a mismatched TEST_LOGIN_SECRET caused a false 401/all-tests-skipped result for the SC#6 rotation-crash-safety suite, requiring diagnosis and restart from source.
Even after the API restart, vitest's failure to load .env caused a second round of false 401s until the secret was exported inline.

Phase 69 falsely displayed as 'Executing' on the dashboard, requiring multi-step root-cause investigation (is_active, then a red-herring UAT-stub fix, then plan_count mismatch) before finding the real plan-scan.cjs substring bug.

The hex/base64 encoding confusion recurred in Phase 74's grant re-mint despite a crypto reviewer explicitly analyzing encoding earlier in the same session (and getting it backwards) — user flagged this as a repeated, systemic pattern.
The user interrupted the Phase 76 planning agent mid-start, requiring cleanup of its cron, empty branch, and worktree state.
Slow pre-commit hooks (~1-2 min, lint-staged in the monorepo) made commits appear to hang or time out even though they had actually landed.
open_items: Phases 76, 78, 79 remain unplanned and unexecuted for milestone v2.0.
Todo logged: re-mint trusts server-provided recipient public key without independent binding verification (MEDIUM security, inherited/newly reachable).
Todo logged: TS rotatedNodes defensive-copy parity for the root/child commit branches (engine.ts ~2064/2235) — not covered by the dirty-resume fix.

Todo logged (high severity): cross-cutting hex/base64 wire-encoding domain hardening — authoritative encoding-contract doc, named boundary codecs, branded types, and a client-vs-DTO contract test, planned as its own hardening phase after Phase 74 merges.
Server DTO doc-comment mislabels (hex vs base64) in apps/api/src/shares/dto/share-response.dto.ts still need fixing, gated on regenerating the OpenAPI client.
Phase 77's TEE wire-field rename was validated atomically both-sides + typecheck but the live sdk-e2e round-trip was never run — flagged as an optional deeper check before merge.
PR #607 (Phase 74) not yet merged — awaiting confirmation that the newly-added WinFsp rename kind-mismatch (Greptile P1) fix passes Windows CI, plus final review-thread resolution.

Cosmetic rename suggested but not applied: rotation_deps.rs test fixture string 'already-wrapped-hex-ciphertext' should be 'already-wrapped-base64-ciphertext' to avoid perpetuating encoding confusion.
